So grounding issue.

Unacknowledged data problems: They ignored the -1 sentinel in customer_age, but age not part of estimand. They also ignored possible missing revenue? No missing. They also didn't address that 'converted' column maybe indicates something, but not needed. So no major unacknowledged problem.

Thus main issue: grounding missing count. Also evidence list includes "Number of loyal completed orders: 157" which is not in output. So need revise.
